title: Tracking House races for 2026 midterms | CNN Politics
text:
Source: CNN

Democrats haveflipped control of the House. But the remaining races that have not yet been projected will determine the strength of the Democratic majority.

Vote counting will continue beyond Election Day, with several races too early for CNN to call. Counting procedures vary by state, meaning some races could be decided quickly while others may take days.

Below are the House races where CNN has yet to project a winner, and races that were projected within the last hour. Follow along as results come in.
